evidence: In the heart of Thong Nhat Park, a serene oasis amidst the lush green canopies, lies the enchanting Mirror House, also known as Nhà gương. This captivating structure, a testament to the enduring spirit of friendship between Vietnam and Czechoslovakia, has been a beloved destination for generations of Hanoians.
